pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "The free plan gives you 100 notebooks, 50 sources per notebook, and 50 chats a day… NotebookLM Plus is $4.99 per month, though it was $7.99/month before a June 2026 price cut. Pro is $19.99 a month, and Ultra starts at $99.99 a month… The paid plans are bundled into Google's consumer AI plans"

nl.description: Gemini Notebook (tot juli 2026 NotebookLM) laat je vragen stellen over je eigen bronnen: pdf's, websites, video's en notities. Antwoorden verwijzen naar de passages in je bronnen, en je kunt samenvattingen en 'Audio Overviews' (podcast-achtige samenvattingen) laten maken.
bestFor: Studeren en onderzoek in eigen bronnen
Samenvattingen met verwijzingen naar de bron
notFor: Onderzoek op het open web zonder eigen bronnen
limitations: Gratis: 50 bronnen per notitieboek en 50 chats per dag

en.description: Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM until July 2026) lets you ask questions about your own sources: PDFs, websites, videos and notes. Answers cite passages in your sources, and you can generate summaries and 'Audio Overviews' (podcast-style summaries).
bestFor: Studying and research in your own sources
notFor: Open-web research without your own sources
limitations: Free: 50 sources per notebook and 50 chats per day
